name: venus_basket_color
theme: an abyssal glass reef read as one weave at every scale — from the black seafloor grove of woven glass towers and the shrimp pair caged in one of them, down a tower's flue and through the square weave of its wall into one glass needle, into the nested glass shells laid about a squared protein thread by the knots riding it, on into the random network of atoms that glass really is, then the shivering nuclei and the woven floor of matter itself — which opens as the braided hollow of a cosmic-web filament, and that corridor folds a second time straight back onto the reef's grove of glass towers

registers.name: reef_commons
registers.palette: ink-navy water, milk-opal glass, rust-orange accents
registers.scene: a black seafloor plain at abyssal depth, woven glass towers rising from the ooze in a loose grove, every tower a hollow tube of fused needles moored by a splayed tuft of glass fibers, rust-orange brittle stars curled over the moorings, squat lobsters crouched among them with claws raised, a long-tailed rattail fish cruising past the tallest tower, a bonded shrimp pair caged in the hollow of a leaning tube, opal glow seeping through every wall, silt haze closing off the furthest towers, no one present

registers.name: basket_tower
registers.palette: milk-opal mesh, ice-blue glow, sable ooze
registers.scene: a tall hollow glass tube rising out of the seafloor ooze, its wall a mesh of fused needles wound with spiral ridges, a domed sieve plate closing the top end with a round vent mouth opening at its middle, sister tubes leaning further off in the silt haze, a splayed tuft of glass fibers gripping the ooze at its foot, ice-blue glow moving through the mesh, ink-black water reaching away past it

registers.name: flue_shaft
registers.palette: rose-opal walls, amber motes, ink hollow
registers.scene: the hollow shaft of a woven glass tube, its wall wrapping the space on all quarters, square windows in the weave opening onto ink-black water, a diagonal brace laid corner to corner across each window, amber motes adrift in the slow current threading up the shaft, fused ridges set at intervals up the wall, rose-opal glow leaking through the mesh

registers.name: woven_wall
registers.palette: ice-blue struts, navy voids, opal seams
registers.scene: a wall of fused glass beams crossing in a square grid, each beam a bundle of hair-fine needles cemented into one rod, diagonal braces laid over every square, each square opening onto a finer weave of needles that opens again onto ink water, a glassy living film webbed over the rods with cell beads studding it, milk-opal glow trapped in the rods, sable gaps deepening as the grid recedes

registers.name: spicule_thicket
registers.palette: opal-rose needles, honey-gold cement, ink gaps
registers.scene: a crowded thicket of glass needles cemented at a junction of the weave, shafts crossing at shallow angles, fine ridges set at intervals down every shaft, honey-gold cement pooled where they meet, one shaft snapped clean across to show a nest of rings in its end, milk-opal glow running the length of each needle, ink gaps opening deeper in the thicket

registers.name: glass_shells
registers.palette: ice-blue shells, opal seams, sable axis
registers.scene: a nested build of glass shells at the cut end of a needle, ring wrapped over ring out to the rim, every shell a laid sheet of glass with a hair-fine organic seam glowing at its join, a squared rose-opal thread running down the axis at the middle, more nested ends showing off in the gloom, ice-blue shimmer crossing the rings

registers.name: axial_filament
registers.palette: rose-opal rod, teal knots, ink space
registers.scene: a squared rod of stacked ribbon-folded units repeating away into ink space, its four faces tiled with the same knot over and over, teal ribbon coils wound through each knot with a cleft at its crest, opal beads of fresh glass budding out of the clefts and crowding the rod's flanks, hair-fine tethers strung from knot to knot, more rods of the same build receding into the gloom

registers.name: silica_network
registers.palette: ice-opal nodes, violet struts, sable voids
registers.scene: an open network of atoms reaching in every direction, ice-blue oxygen atoms bridging rose-opal silicon cores into rings of unequal size, the rings joined corner to corner with no repeat anywhere in the weave, wide sable voids opening through it, a violet shimmer running every strut, the weave dimming into gloom at its furthest reach
registers.loop_target: an open network of atoms, ice-blue struts bridging rose-opal cores into unequal rings

registers.name: nucleus_shoal
registers.palette: rose-gold droplets, opal shimmer, starless ink
registers.scene: a shoal of shivering droplets hanging in starless emptiness, each droplet a crowd of rose-gold and opal spheres shuddering under a skin of radiance, droplets sown at every distance and dimming into the void, faint sparks flickering in the gaps among them, nothing else in any direction

registers.name: nuclear_pasta
registers.palette: molten opal sheets, violet seams, black corridors
registers.scene: a weave of molten matter with no gap anywhere in it, spheres kneaded into wavy glowing sheets and braided rods, plate laid over plate with black corridors threading among them, rope-twisted strands bridging the plates, violet radiance seeping from every seam, the weave repeating away with no end in any direction

registers.name: filament_corridor
registers.palette: ice-blue haze, rose-gold knots, black voids
registers.scene: the hollow of a cosmic-web filament, its walls braided strands of galaxies twisting down the corridor, rose-gold knots glowing where the braids cross, ice-blue haze hanging the whole length of the passage, black voids showing through the gaps in the braided walls, thousands of far galaxies strewn down the corridor

music_theme: a submerged archive dive — a low sub-drone under struck glass tones, one deep kick on every downbeat as the weave tightens scale by scale, the pulse narrowing to a single held tone through the atom and nucleus bars, a wide struck bloom where matter's weave opens into the cosmic corridor, and a keener, softer one as the corridor drops back onto the reef floor
